03 / ABOUT

Curious by nature. Practical by approach.

I’m Kefas, a Computer Science undergraduate at Miva Open University, based in Abuja.

I’m interested in the connections between applications, infrastructure and intelligent systems. My projects give me a place to turn theory into working code, investigate failures, and document what I learn.

My next step is an internship or junior role where I can contribute to a team and keep developing my engineering judgment.

HOW I APPROACH THE WORK

  1. Understand the problem.Start with the workflow and the people using it.
  2. Make it inspectable.Keep code, configuration and decisions together.
  3. Improve through evidence.Test assumptions and document the limits.
